classification: CONFIRMATORY causal bridge. Rollout-time scaffold only: no training, no checkpoint write, no parameter change. This is NOT the final learned-crossover claim.
authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-21 ('GO: native A vs scaffolded A-prime vs B, both poles, fresh n=128'): run one decisive bridge experiment on the frozen 4v4 learned specialists, adding native pi_A as a third arm on the same fresh seeds so the effect of the scaffold can be separated from fresh-block variation.
QUESTION: Does imposing the already-confirmed balanced coordination structure (2 attackers / 2 defenders) on pi_A restore the payoff separation that the learned 4v4 specialists failed to produce?

WHY_THIS_LEVER.prior_pattern: Every earlier 4v4 learned repair passed Delta_A and failed Delta_B (ROLE +0.203 / -0.047; Assignment-v1 +0.125 / -0.016; GETFLAG-preserve -0.047 / +0.016; entity repair +0.273 / -0.156). Those attempts pushed on pi_B.

baseline_verified_from_the_sealed_rows.source: confirmatory_b3_entity_repair_corrected_specialist_crossover_eval_rows.csv (sha256 3f9b862448c27aff6cf804c9bbb686d07f2e5173d88be91593fd893febf46025), seeds 18300001-18300128, recomputed 2026-09-21 with the evaluator's own bootstrap
baseline_verified_from_the_sealed_rows.note: matches the earlier memory-only figures to every digit; the previously flagged memory-only row is now verified against the sealed artifact.

WHY_THIS_LEVER.reading: pi_A is a strong generalist (0.74 on Pole B) and pi_B is weak on both poles. Delta_B = WR(pi_B,B) - WR(pi_A,B) cannot be positive unless pi_A is made worse on B, or pi_B better. The scripted 2A/2D composition wins only about 0.11-0.15 on Pole B, so keeping pi_A balanced when it faces B is the lever this experiment tests, rather than pushing on pi_B again.

arms.pi_A: native pi_A3 (entity repair), all four agents policy-driven.
arms.A_prime: A' = pi_A3 + 2D: the same pi_A3, but exactly two of the four agents have their resolved target forced to MacroAction.DEFEND's live-state target for the whole episode. The other two agents are driven by pi_A3 exactly as in the native arm.
arms.pi_B: native pi_B3-corrected, all four agents policy-driven. Never scaffolded.

ARMS_AND_DESIGN.pole_meaning: the certified 4v4 poles under STRATEGIC_DEMAND_4v4_POLE_B3_3_N192_CERTIFICATION.json: Pole A = OP6 + frozen overlay (min_alive_for_defender=4, live genome SDS2_A_payoff_INIT_3); Pole B = the B3-3 candidate SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1 (lock_defender 10, enable_2v1, min_alive_for_defender 4). Pole B is NEVER canonical OP7.

fresh_seed_block.disjoint_from: every other registered block, including the sealed 4v4 crossover blocks 16700001-128, 17800001-128, 18300001-128 and 18500001-128 and the 6v6 blocks 20900001-096 and 21000001-096

ARMS_AND_DESIGN.n_episodes: 3 arms x 2 poles x 128 seeds = 768 FULL 4v4 episodes, deterministic actions, cuda, torch.no_grad().
ARMS_AND_DESIGN.pairing: the same 128 seed values in every cell and arm, so every contrast below is paired by seed.

scaffold_identity_rotation.pairs: the six unordered pairs of the four agent slots: (0,1) (0,2) (0,3) (1,2) (1,3) (2,3)
scaffold_identity_rotation.rule: pair = PAIRS[seed % 6], the same pair for every arm and pole at a given seed (only the A_prime arm uses it).
scaffold_identity_rotation.why: so spawn identity cannot masquerade as structure.
scaffold_identity_rotation.disclosed_imbalance: 128 is not a multiple of 6, so the six pairs are used 22, 22, 21, 21, 21, 21 times (max minus min = 1). Exactly uniform coverage would need 126 or 132 seeds; n=128 was the PI's choice and is kept.

MECHANISM.statement: experiments.probe_learned_composition.install_forced_defend_target, applied once per overridden agent. It patches the resolved-target layer (the output of _build_targets_from_action) so the agent takes MacroAction.DEFEND's live-state target, calling the real target resolution a second time; it never writes commit_macro, so the action-mask and the n_macros=5 observation schema are undisturbed. The mechanism is N-agnostic and supports several agents per episode.

source_pin.note: byte-identical to the file that ran the 6v6 causal bridge and confirmation; the contracts stage refuses to run if the hash differs.

MECHANISM.two_defender_contract: before the block is spent, the contracts stage verifies at 4v4 that a two-agent injection reproduces a natural scripted two-defender team bit-for-bit (position, alive, tagged, carrying for all four agents on every tick, and the final outcome), on two different (pole, pair) cells, at n_macros 8 and 5.

ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.primary_endpoint: win rate (the crossover currency used throughout this line).

primary_contrasts.Delta_A_prime: WR(A', Pole A) - WR(pi_B, Pole A), paired by seed.
primary_contrasts.Delta_B_prime: WR(pi_B, Pole B) - WR(A', Pole B), paired by seed.

ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.statistics: paired bootstrap 95% interval over seeds; 20000 resamples, alpha 0.05, rng seed 7 (the routine used throughout this line).

secondary_mechanism_diagnostics_not_gate.I_A: WR(A', Pole A) - WR(pi_A, Pole A): what the scaffold did to A on its own pole.
secondary_mechanism_diagnostics_not_gate.I_B: WR(A', Pole B) - WR(pi_A, Pole B): what the scaffold did to A on the opposing pole.
secondary_mechanism_diagnostics_not_gate.hoped_for_pattern: the scaffold preserves A's competence on Pole A (I_A not clearly negative) while suppressing A's unwanted competence on Pole B (I_B negative). This is an interpretation aid; neither quantity is a pass gate and neither enters the label.
secondary_mechanism_diagnostics_not_gate.native_crossover_on_the_fresh_block: Delta_A = WR(pi_A,A) - WR(pi_B,A) and Delta_B = WR(pi_B,B) - WR(pi_A,B), reported for reference against the sealed 18300001-128 baseline. Descriptive.

ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.descriptive_also_reported: for every contrast above, the paired difference in Blue goals per episode and in score margin, and all six cell means. These are non-gating and carry no label; goal volume is included because the frozen win endpoint is insensitive to goal production after a first goal (a limitation found in the 6v6 line).

precedence: AUDIT_FAILED (sealed status != SEALED) overrides everything and certifies no label
TERMINAL_OUTCOMES_FROZEN.SCAFFOLDED_CROSSOVER_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Either lower bound is not above zero. Which side or sides cleared is reported descriptively, not as a separate label.
TERMINAL_OUTCOMES_FROZEN.always_reported: both primary contrasts with intervals, I_A and I_B with intervals, the native crossover, the goal and margin counterparts, and all six cell means, whichever label results.

BRANCH_RULES_FROZEN.if_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Close this branch. No 3-1 composition, no defender-horizon tweak, no change of overridden identities, no re-run of the block.
BRANCH_RULES_FROZEN.if_CONFIRMED: Licenses only the statement below and nothing else: A's balanced coordination, imposed as an external scaffold, is sufficient to recover 4v4 A/B separation at the scaffolded-controller level. PPO to internalize the structure into pi_A, removal of the scaffold, and the fully learned crossover are a separate, later step and are NOT started or authorized here.

INTERPRETATION_GUARD_FROZEN.sentence: A' is pi_A with an externally imposed defender structure. A scaffolded crossover is a causal bridge showing what the balanced structure does to the payoff separation; it is not a fully learned crossover and must not be reported as one.

checkpoints.note: the same two checkpoints, by hash prefix, that the sealed corrected crossover evaluated (its log records sha 94dde69d091a... and 021342c84bbe...).

pole_attestation.rule: both poles are attested before any episode against the governing certification (fields and config hash), through experiments.pole_attestation, with the B3-3 genome file supplied so canonical OP7 can never be scored. Each episode additionally asserts the LIVE opponent batch and the live min_alive_for_defender equals 4, and fails closed otherwise. This is the defect that invalidated an earlier 4v4 experiment (a pi_B trained on canonical OP7 but scored on B3-3).

INTEGRITY_FROZEN.native_path_parity: the contracts stage replays 16 episodes of the sealed corrected crossover (seeds 18300001-18300004, both policies, both poles) through this experiment's own runner and requires the recorded (blue, red, win, margin) exactly. Parity only; those seeds are spent; no new evidence, no registry interaction.
INTEGRITY_FROZEN.policies_are_plain_specialists: neither loaded policy may be latent-, role-, or assignment-conditioned (fail closed).
INTEGRITY_FROZEN.no_training: no PPO, no optimizer, no parameter change; a parameter digest of both policies is equal before and after every shard.
INTEGRITY_FROZEN.no_interim_reading: progress COUNTS only while the block runs; no outcome is read or printed, no early stopping, no top-up of the block.
INTEGRITY_FROZEN.sharding: sharding across processes with an append-only resume file per shard is an execution detail only: episodes are independent and deterministic, so it cannot change a result. The analysis refuses to run unless all 768 cells are present and is sealed through the formal audit pipeline (rows, checkpoints, seed class, contrast claims re-derived from the rows).

both poles attested against the governing certification with the B3-3 genome; live Pole B genome id is SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1 with lock_defender 10, enable_2v1 true, min_alive_for_defender 4

claim_boundary: Two frozen 4v4 learned specialists, the two certified 4v4 poles, a rollout-time scaffold on pi_A only, fresh sealed_confirmatory seeds spent for the first time here.
claim_ceiling: At most: SCAFFOLDED_CROSSOVER_CONFIRMED -- imposing 2A/2D on pi_A is sufficient to recover 4v4 A/B separation at the scaffolded-controller level. Not a fully learned crossover, not a mechanism beyond I_A and I_B, and not a statement about 6v6.
